provenance.source: Handwritten F0 48 0F C1 00 bytes, initial register/memory bytes and literal expected state; tests/cpu/generate_stage2_lock_xadd_qword_memory.py only serializes these constants. No assembler, emulator, or semantic expected-value generator.
provenance.specification: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol.2D XADD plus Vol.2A LOCK prefix rules: the old memory destination is copied to the source register, the source is added to the destination, and arithmetic flags reflect the sum. LOCK is accepted only for a memory destination. The source register is also the effective-address base. This local-only fixture crosses two adjacent private-RAM regions; it makes no shared-memory, SMP, or host-atomicity claim.
provenance.specification_version: Intel SDM revision 093 (334569-093US), Vol.2D XADD pp.6-23–6-24 and Vol.2A LOCK prefix; project S2-21f
